# Bundle and Installation

Another entire chapter of packaging and installing modules is dedicated on this part of Chapter 5. Bundling the module part is easy as it has similar mechanism to `R CMD build`, done by running `carrier bundle .` command, then you'll get a tarball archive containing `{box}`-`{carrier}` module. And the installation part is also easy by running `carrier install <path-where-the-archive-lived>.tar.gz`.
